universe_completeness.source: all higher elementary 2-kernel records with the nonsplit marker in the bound PerfectGroups metadata inventory
universe_completeness.excluded_nonabelian_kernel_records: retained in the separate nonabelian-kernel lane

preflight_measurements.construction: exact finite presentation and every listed faithful coset block, reconstructed by SymPy
preflight_measurements.marking: all kernel translates of the frozen words S=accbxbccb and T=cacaccwb with orders 2 and 3
preflight_measurements.gauge: all simultaneous conjugations by the full elementary kernel
preflight_measurements.order: family key, then lexicographic permutation pair
preflight_measurements.generation_gate: Schreier-Sims subgroup order for every gauge-orbit representative
preflight_measurements.rank_gate: not applicable at preflight; no shadow or reduction image is opened

positive_control.each_constructed_record: group order 504*2^d, kernel order 2^d, kernel element orders 1:1 and 2:(2^d-1)

stopping_and_environment.preflight: consume all seven records even when an earlier record has no generating marking
stopping_and_environment.timeout_meaning: construction unavailable in this environment; no mathematical nonexistence inference
stopping_and_environment.downstream: freeze all generating marked orbits before opening the first shadow; stop at the first missing target key
